the model says the meaning changed: The diff rewrites how the judge model's question quotes an older record's words with their date, or says none were found. It adds a transcript search (`_own_words`, `_said_in`) and a new "I found none of your words…" line, which is what SR-249 EX-1 and EX-2 describe.; brought to the owner as a card: What you want: iaso approves a record for you only when it is sure what you meant. Otherwise a model asks you questions until it is clear. Nothing gets approved on supporting evidence alone.

What the requirement says: for an older record whose words iaso never saw you write, iaso searches your past sessions in this project, reading only messages you typed. The question then either quotes the words it found, with their date, or says it found none and asks what you meant. A match in a past session approves nothing on its own, and a record you already approved is skipped. The requirement still fits what you want, so the requirement is not what's wrong.

The change: the question builder now does that search itself. If the model gives no quote, iaso takes the older record's own words and looks for them in your past sessions. When it finds them it quotes them with the day, like "4 Oct". When it doesn't, it adds "I found none of your words about this in your past sessions." Quotes are now optional, so a question is no longer rejected for lacking one. The change also tidies the header, drops questions you already answered, and avoids repeating the same debug question.

All of this seems to match the requirement's examples. Nothing in the code shown approves a record from a past-session match.

What's unclear: there is no logged message from you for the turn that made this change, so I can't tell whether you asked for it. Two small points also need your eye:
- The words are found with one matching rule and dated with another. If those rules ever disagree, iaso could say it found nothing when it did.
- When a record already rests on things you wrote, no quote is shown and the "found none" line isn't added either.; the card is not offered until it is complete, it lacks: what option 1 ("Keep the change: it does what the requirement asks; just confirm it") does and leaves undone; what option 2 ("Keep the change, but make finding and dating the words use the same matching rule") does and leaves undone; what option 3 ("Undo the change and go back to requiring a quote in every question") does and leaves undone; why the recommended option is recommended (iaso stale card SR-249#3 --consequences "..." --why "...")
